content.text:
Plan submitted — all 18 rules searched and assigned candidate locations.

**Summary of the review map:**

- **Located and substantive:** LOL-CAP (p0727 consequential-damages waiver, no cap surfaced), INDEMN (mutual 16.1/16.2 plus procedure), NONCOMPETE/EXCLUSIVITY (Section 8.2 Competing Product covenant plus Article IX supply exclusivity), T4C (13.2 termination without cause, gated on a redacted date), GOVLAW (18.3 plus ICC arbitration with a split Osaka/New York seat), ASSIGN (18.9/18.10 plus Change in Control definition), IP (Section 11.1 ownership, Section 2.6 grant-back, Article XIV assignments), LICENSE (Article II grant stack), AUDIT (7.4 records inspection plus GxP site audits), LD (14.3, apparently running in our favour), WARRANTY (Article XV reps plus implied-warranty disclaimer), MINCOMMIT (no commitment in the body; forecasting deferred to supply agreements), TRANSITION (full Article XIV wind-down).
- **Likely absent:** MFN, NOSOLICIT (both favourable to us), INSURANCE (genuine gap worth raising).
- **Flagged for careful full-section reading:** sec-p0715 for any monetary cap, p0765 for the governing-law choice (snippet truncated), and Article XIV cost allocation.
